_comment: Default baseline configurations for scorpion.sif, which contains this file: `scorpion.sif DOMAIN TASK PLAN --config NAME` runs NAME's options (combinable with other options such as --preprocess). Every configuration uses Scorpion's defaults; pho, ocp and operatorcounting need an image built with CPLEX.

scorpion.description: Scorpion's recommended configuration (sys_scp + cartesian, perimstar, partial order reduction); its README adds --preprocess

cartesian.description: online saturated cost partitioning over Cartesian CEGAR abstractions

merge-and-shrink.description: merge-and-shrink, the configuration Scorpion's documentation recommends (no defaults exist)

lmcut-seq.description: operator counting with state-equation and LM-cut constraints
